//lastChange: Messages phase 3 — internal threads (2026-09-26). Staff-to-staff threads about a patient that structurally cannot reach that patient. Checked before building: the assistant conversation history is loaded BY CONVERSATION in worker.js, so an internal note — its own conversation — is never in the set rather than filtered out of it, which is what made one message store safe. GOLDEN-007 found something while being written: outboundMessage is NOT the only caller of the transport (worker.js, routes/orders.js, routes/whatsapp.js and staffAlert.js all call sendText directly), and each is legitimate because it fires only where there is NO conversation. So the invariant is every send that NAMES a conversation goes through the one path, and the test pins that caller list closed. The guard was then mutation-checked twice: removed entirely (2 golden tests red) and moved after the transport (007a red on its ordering assertion). Three existing tests changed with the product, none relaxed — one was TIGHTENED, from "no export matches send|reply|create|start" to "nothing matches send|reply and the only creator is createInternalThread". A pre-existing defect was surfaced and NOT fixed here: medications addMedication lets updated_at default to the database now() while updateMedication sets it from Node new Date(), so a clinical record last-updated time can move backwards; it fails ~1 run in 6, is deliberately absent from knownFailures, and has its own task.
